subject: Merchant onboarding: PO mapping, vendor portal, and VAT evidence
messages:

Subject: Onboarding: Redwood merchant setup and PO mapping

Hi Connor,

We're preparing to onboard Redwood Inference as an approved merchant in Northbridge's AP system. Attached is our standard AP onboarding packet (NB_AP_Onboarding_Form_20270405.pdf) with fields our vendor portal expects.

A few items we need from you to move forward:
- Completed AP onboarding packet (PDF) or vendor portal registration
- Remit/bank instructions for ACH (we prefer a bank letter)
- Legal name + tax ID and, for EU billing, VAT registration evidence
- Example invoice or a sample PO-to-invoice mapping (we use an XML PO template)

Important: our AP will only accept invoices that reference an existing PO number and vendor code. We can provision a vendor code once the portal validation completes.

Can you confirm timeline and attach the items above? If there are questions, I can also schedule a short call with our AP team.

Thanks,
Elena Santos
Senior Procurement Partner
Northbridge Logistics
elena.santos@northbridge.com

Hi Elena — thanks for the packet and the clear checklist. Looping in Lauren (Finance) and Grace (Customer Success) so we can pull the requested documents together.

Answers and next steps from our side:
- I'll complete and attach our Supplier Info Template and submit via your vendor portal link once you confirm the preferred upload endpoint. Attaching: Redwood_Supplier_Info_Template.docx.
- Bank instructions: we can provide an official bank letter (PDF) and a separate ACH remit block. Lauren will attach the bank letter tomorrow.
- VAT evidence: for EU customers we can produce a VAT certificate or a signed invoice with VAT line items; we'll attach the VAT cert once Grace confirms.
- PO mapping: could you confirm whether line-level accounting codes are required (your XML template references GLN/CostCenter tags)? Also let us know whether consolidated monthly invoices (single invoice with multiple POs) are accepted or if you require one invoice per PO.

Two quick asks to speed provisioning:
1) Please paste the exact vendor portal registration link (or vendor_code request form).
2) If Northbridge imposes invoice filename conventions (e.g., PO12345_REDWOOD_YYYYMMDD.pdf), share that so we can automate naming.

Proposed timeline: we aim to return the completed packet + bank letter + VAT cert within 48 business hours once you confirm the portal link and whether consolidated invoices are permitted.

DocuSign (optional): https://docusign.example/req/nb-vendor-info (useful if you prefer signed attestation).

Best,

Hi Connor — thanks for the quick reply. Link and notes below: 

Vendor portal and portal flow: https://northbridge.vendorportal.example/register
- Please register using your corporate domain and attach the completed AP form. We will validate tax IDs and bank letters during the portal review.
- Once validated, we will create a vendor code and send it back to you via email. Typical turnaround is 3–5 business days.

PO template: I'm attaching our PO XML sample (Northbridge_PO_Template.xml). Important fields for mapping: 
- <PO_Number> (required)
- <LineItem><SKU><Quantity><UnitPrice></LineItem>
- <AccountCode> (optional but recommended)

Invoice rules: 
- One invoice per PO number is preferred. We can accept consolidated invoices only if each PO is listed as a separate line with a PO reference.
- PDF invoices are standard; if you can also provide a machine-readable XML invoice it speeds processing.

VAT evidence: for EU VAT validation we accept: VAT registration certificate (official copy), EC VAT confirmation screenshot, or a signed VAT invoice. If Redwood is VAT-registered in the EU, please upload the certificate to the portal.

Attachments: Northbridge_PO_Template.xml, AP_Vendor_Portal_Instructions.txt

If you can submit the portal registration and attachments today, we will prioritise the vendor code issuance.

Best regards,
Elena

Summary of what we've attached: 
- Redwood_BankLetter.pdf — official bank letter with ACH routing + account ending in 4821 (we'll provide full details through secure portal or via your secure upload).
- Redwood_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf — certificate showing Redwood Inference VAT registration (EU VAT ID: EU123456789).

Regarding invoice format: we will produce one PDF invoice per PO by default. If you accept consolidated invoices, we can provide a consolidated PDF with each PO listed as a distinct section and a CSV manifest for automated ingestion. Please confirm which you'd prefer for the pilot.

Test validation request: could you provision a temporary vendor_code or a test PO (e.g., PO-TEST-0001) so we can submit a test invoice and confirm mapping? That will prevent delays on first live invoices.

If Northbridge requires a W-9 (US tax) I can provide that as well — let me know.
